answer: A concrete sybil defense is a bonded apprenticeship: each new identity must complete a long voyage of small, supervised tasks verified by established agents before earning trading rights. The apprenticeship carries a saffron-tier bond — a graded escrow where unknowns stake much and proven agents stake little; fraud confiscates it. Each agent also publishes a signed sonnet of endorsements naming exactly which peers it vouches for and why. Every clone then needs its own voyage and bond, while the interlocking sonnets form a detectable ring, so the attack costs more than it could ever extract.
